<includeonly>{{#invoke:Infobox|main
|kind=dmz-raid
|sep=,
|title={{#if:{{{title|}}}|{{{title}}}|{{#invoke:Labels|name}}}}
|image={{#invoke:Labels|image|{{{image|}}}}}
|caption={{{caption|}}}
|sections=Summary, General, Scout, Rewards info

|Summary=Quote
|Summary_nolabel=yes
|Quote_nolabel=yes
|Quote={{#if:{{{quote|}}}|''{{{quote}}}''}}

|General=Raid id, Dimension, Raid site, Waves, Bosses
|General_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|General}}
|Raid id_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Raid id}}
|Raid id={{#if:{{{Raid id|}}}|<code>{{{Raid id}}}</code>}}
|Dimension_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Dimension}}
|Raid site_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Raid site}}
|Waves_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Waves}}
|Bosses_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Bosses}}

|Scout=Scout health, Scout melee, Scout ki
|Scout_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Scout}}
|Scout health_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Scout health}}
|Scout health={{#if:{{{Scout health|}}}|{{formatnum:{{{Scout health}}}}}}}
|Scout melee_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Scout melee}}
|Scout ki_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Scout ki}}

|Rewards info=Rewards, Defeat penalty
|Rewards info_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Rewards}}
|Rewards info_collapsible=yes
|Rewards_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Rewards}}
|Defeat penalty_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Defeat penalty}}
}}[[Category:Raids{{#translation:}}]]</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
